question: Doanh thu theo phân khúc khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Top 5 danh mục có doanh thu cao nhất

answer.sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Số đơn hàng theo phân khúc khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY orders DESC

question: Giá trị trung bình mỗi đơn theo thị trường

answer.sql: SELECT o.market, SUM(t.order_total) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(item_total) AS order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t JOIN orders o ON t.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.market ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: Số khách hàng có đơn bị hủy theo quốc gia của khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'CANCELED' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY customers DESC

question: Tỷ lệ đơn có nguy cơ giao trễ theo phân khúc khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(CASE WHEN o.late_delivery_risk THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS late_rate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY late_rate DESC

question: Số lượng bán theo danh mục ở thị trường Europe

answer.sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE o.market = 'Europe' GROUP BY cat.category_name ORDER BY quantity DESC

question: Lợi nhuận theo phương thức vận chuyển và phân khúc khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT o.shipping_mode, c.segment, SUM(oi.profit) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY o.shipping_mode, c.segment ORDER BY o.shipping_mode, c.segment

question: Số sản phẩm theo bộ phận

answer.sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN departments d ON cat.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY products DESC

question: Số ngày giao hàng thực tế trung bình của đơn có sản phẩm thuộc danh mục Cleats

answer.sql: SELECT AVG(o.days_for_shipping_real) AS avg_days FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id IN (SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Cleats')

question: Doanh thu theo phòng ban

answer.sql: SELECT d.department_name, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN departments d ON cat.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Doanh thu theo danh mục và phân khúc khách hàng

answer.sql: SELECT cat.category_name, c.segment, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY cat.category_name, c.segment ORDER BY cat.category_name, c.segment

question: Top 10 sản phẩm có lợi nhuận cao nhất

answer.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.profit) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 10

question: Số khách hàng đã mua hàng theo phòng ban

answer.sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN departments d ON cat.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY customers DESC

question: Doanh thu theo tháng năm 2017

answer.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month, SUM(oi.item_total) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2017 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY month

question: Lợi nhuận theo phòng ban ở thị trường LATAM

answer.sql: SELECT d.department_name, SUM(oi.profit) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN departments d ON cat.department_id = d.department_id WHERE o.market = 'LATAM' GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY profit DESC

question: Tỷ lệ bỏ học theo môn học

answer.sql: SELECT code_module, AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS withdrawn_rate FROM students GROUP BY code_module ORDER BY withdrawn_rate DESC

question: Số sinh viên theo kết quả cuối khóa

answer.sql: SELECT final_result, COUNT(*) AS students FROM students GROUP BY final_result ORDER BY students DESC

question: Điểm trung bình theo loại bài đánh giá

answer.sql: SELECT a.assessment_type, AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score FROM student_assessments sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment GROUP BY a.assessment_type ORDER BY avg_score DESC

question: Điểm trung bình theo kết quả cuối khóa của sinh viên

answer.sql: SELECT s.final_result, AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score FROM student_assessments sa JOIN students s ON sa.code_module = s.code_module AND sa.code_presentation = s.code_presentation AND sa.id_student = s.id_student GROUP BY s.final_result ORDER BY avg_score DESC

question: Điểm trung bình bài TMA theo nhóm imd_band

answer.sql: SELECT s.imd_band, AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score FROM student_assessments sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment JOIN students s ON sa.code_module = s.code_module AND sa.code_presentation = s.code_presentation AND sa.id_student = s.id_student WHERE a.assessment_type = 'TMA' GROUP BY s.imd_band ORDER BY s.imd_band

question: Tỷ lệ bỏ học theo môn và kỳ kèm độ dài học phần

answer.sql: SELECT s.code_module, s.code_presentation, c.module_presentation_length, AVG(CASE WHEN s.final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS withdrawn_rate FROM students s JOIN courses c ON s.code_module = c.code_module AND s.code_presentation = c.code_presentation GROUP BY s.code_module, s.code_presentation, c.module_presentation_length ORDER BY withdrawn_rate DESC

question: Lượt bấm trung bình mỗi sinh viên theo kết quả cuối khóa

answer.sql: SELECT s.final_result, AVG(t.clicks) AS avg_clicks FROM (SELECT code_module, code_presentation, id_student, SUM(sum_click) AS clicks FROM student_daily_clicks GROUP BY code_module, code_presentation, id_student) t JOIN students s ON t.code_module = s.code_module AND t.code_presentation = s.code_presentation AND t.id_student = s.id_student GROUP BY s.final_result ORDER BY avg_clicks DESC

question: Số sinh viên theo nhóm tuổi và giới tính

answer.sql: SELECT age_band, gender, COUNT(*) AS students FROM students GROUP BY age_band, gender ORDER BY age_band, gender

question: Tỷ lệ rút học theo vùng

answer.sql: SELECT region, AVG(CASE WHEN final_result = 'Withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS withdrawn_rate FROM students GROUP BY region ORDER BY withdrawn_rate DESC

question: Số sinh viên theo môn và năm bắt đầu học phần

answer.sql: SELECT s.code_module, c.presentation_year, COUNT(*) AS students FROM students s JOIN courses c ON s.code_module = c.code_module AND s.code_presentation = c.code_presentation GROUP BY s.code_module, c.presentation_year ORDER BY s.code_module, c.presentation_year

question: Điểm trung bình theo môn và loại bài đánh giá

answer.sql: SELECT a.code_module, a.assessment_type, AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score FROM student_assessments sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment GROUP BY a.code_module, a.assessment_type ORDER BY a.code_module, a.assessment_type

question: Điểm trung bình bài thi Exam theo giới tính

answer.sql: SELECT s.gender, AVG(sa.score) AS avg_score FROM student_assessments sa JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment JOIN students s ON sa.code_module = s.code_module AND sa.code_presentation = s.code_presentation AND sa.id_student = s.id_student WHERE a.assessment_type = 'Exam' GROUP BY s.gender ORDER BY s.gender

question: Số sinh viên hủy đăng ký theo vùng

answer.sql: SELECT s.region, COUNT(*) AS students FROM registrations r JOIN students s ON r.code_module = s.code_module AND r.code_presentation = s.code_presentation AND r.id_student = s.id_student WHERE r.date_unregistration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY students DESC

question: Số tài liệu học trực tuyến theo loại hoạt động và năm bắt đầu học phần

answer.sql: SELECT v.activity_type, c.presentation_year, COUNT(*) AS materials FROM vle_materials v JOIN courses c ON v.code_module = c.code_module AND v.code_presentation = c.code_presentation GROUP BY v.activity_type, c.presentation_year ORDER BY v.activity_type, c.presentation_year
